body.content: Double check the boundary: n < 10,000 means n_max = 9999. m_max = 9999 + 2005 = 12004. 64 * 13^2 = 64 * 169 = 10816 (fits). 64 * 17^2 = 64 * 289 = 18496 (too big). 729 * 2^2 = 2916 (fits). 729 * 3^2 = 729 * 9 = 6561, but p and q must be distinct primes for the factor count (a+1)(b+1) to be (6+1)(2+1)=21. If p=q, it becomes p^8, which has 9 factors. So p=3, q=3 is excluded. 729 * 5^2 = 729 * 25 = 18225 (too big). The list {2916, 3136, 7744, 10816} seems exhaustive.
body.why_keep_this: Confirms the exclusion of p=q cases and verifies the upper bound of m.
